nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: This repo's Next.js version has breaking changes - APIs, conventions, and file structure may all differ from an agent's training data. Agents must read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and heed deprecation notices. The block is written and re-added by `next dev`; removing it from a diff only re-creates the uncommitted change, so committing it with the work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: next dev (agent-file generator)
nodes.rationale: The `next dev` command that writes and re-adds the nextjs-agent-rules block to AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: generate-agent-files.js
nodes.rationale: node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js - the file where the agent-rules block generation is verified.
